t: An assembled four-wheel robot with block coding and a simulator.
steps: Register your school with Engino to buy the Basic Edition.
Check retailers such as School Specialty, Nasco and TTS for stock.
Read the included teacher's guide and connectivity guides.
Install KEIRO on a computer or device.
Connect the robot by USB, Bluetooth or Wi-Fi.
Run a first program in the ENVIRO simulator.
Run the same program on the robot.
